packet_provenance.effect: Repairs the predecessor's governance source span and schema/action classification while preserving the donor-source identity separation result.

semantic_atoms.finding: handoff() creates durable entityos_arbeitspaket/capsule state and explicitly does not itself delegate or spawn a native child.
The donor specification requires stern.py handoff before spawning, lastschutz before parallel build-agent spawning, and stern.py reconcile afterwards.
The versioned donor plugin config registers SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionEnd and PreCompact, but not SubagentStart/SubagentStop/TaskCreated/TaskCompleted.

Current official Claude Code hooks documentation specifies call-scoped tool_use_id on PostToolUse and an Agent-specific tool_response.agentId on successful/async Agent PostToolUse. The platform ABI therefore documents a same-event tool_use_id -> agent_id join.
Subagent lifecycle uses agent_id while TaskCreated/TaskCompleted use task_id; no evidence supports treating task_id as an alias for native Agent-run identity.

The inspected durable handoff path does not issue the Agent call or persist its call-scoped tool_use_id. After the current platform ABI crosscheck, the remaining causal gap is paket_id -> exact Agent tool_use_id, not tool_use_id -> agent_id.

architecture_effect.purpose: Close durable work-intent -> exact native Agent invocation -> native child -> result re-entry provenance without timing/order/session heuristics.

identity_domains.parent_session_id: context only; never sufficient execution identity
identity_domains.spawn_tool_use_id: exact parent Agent tool invocation identity
identity_domains.agent_id: native subagent run identity returned by the Agent PostToolUse ABI when observed
identity_domains.agent_run_generation: run/resume generation if a stable agent identity may resume
identity_domains.task_id: optional independent Task lifecycle identity only when actually observed
identity_domains.child_tool_use_id: call-scoped identity for child tool execution

join_law: paket_id -> spawn_tool_use_id MUST NOT be inferred from timing, order, session_id, description similarity, agent type/name or narrative continuity.

Current official platform documentation resolves tool_use_id -> agent_id at the ABI/spec level via the same Agent PostToolUse event, but target-host runtime evidence is still required before runtime credit.
task_id remains an optional independent namespace and MUST NOT be coerced into agent_id.
Concurrent Agent calls MUST remain distinguishable by call-scoped invocation identity.
Reconcile success requires a typed result receipt bound to the exact WorkExecutionBinding and source/runtime identity.

contradictions_preserved: Donor governance specifies handoff -> spawn -> reconcile, while handoff() explicitly does not spawn; these are specification and implementation-layer facts, not a contradiction to be smoothed away.
The donor plugin config lacks explicit child lifecycle hooks, while host/user/managed settings may add them outside the repository; installed composition remains UNKNOWN.
The earlier 10:12 successor treated tool_use_id -> agent_id as undocumented; current official hooks documentation provides Agent PostToolUse tool_response.agentId and supersedes that narrow claim.
A deterministic paket_id -> Agent tool_use_id binding may already exist in host-private coordinator/transcript state outside the inspected repository; it remains unobserved rather than denied.

required_actions: add or verify a deterministic pre-spawn/pending-spawn binding that associates paket_id and package_generation with the exact Agent tool_use_id
capture target installed Agent PostToolUse and verify tool_use_id plus tool_response.agentId for foreground and background launches before runtime promotion
capture SubagentStart/SubagentStop as an independent agent_id lifecycle crosscheck when available; do not require task_id unless a real Task lifecycle participates
persist the exact WorkExecutionBinding and typed result receipt before reconcile can promote delegated completion
run at least two overlapping Agent invocations and prove package/call/agent/result attribution does not cross-wire

next_exact_gate: Triggerword-4 build/verification lane: deterministically bind paket_id/package_generation to the exact Agent tool_use_id, then capture one harmless target Agent PostToolUse payload proving tool_use_id + tool_response.agentId and cross-check its agent_id against child lifecycle evidence where available; finally falsify timing/order joins with two overlapping Agent calls before runtime credit.
